transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I don’t know… I guess I’ve just stopped caring about things. Stuff I used to look forward to—fishing, working in the woodshop—it’s all just sitting there. Even when my kids want to play chess, I’m kind of just… going through the motions.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time?
I don’t know… “sad” maybe isn’t the word I’d use. Empty, yeah… kind of numb most days, I guess.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About… a year and a half. Maybe a little more. Since my wife’s health stuff got bad and everything at home changed… so, yeah, around a year and seven months.
Do you still enjoy things you used to find pleasurable, or has that changed for you?

Yeah… it’s changed. I don’t really get much out of the stuff I used to. My fishing gear’s just sitting in the garage, haven’t touched it. The woodshop feels like another job now. Even chess with the kids… I’ll do it, but I’m not really there.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?

Not really. I mean… I guess I still do things if the kids ask, like chess, but it’s more like I’m just going through the motions. Fishing, the woodshop… I just don’t care about them the way I used to.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
I don’t know… maybe some. I wouldn’t say I’m calm, exactly, but I haven’t really thought about it that way.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?
Yeah… a bit. I’m not really eating much. Food just doesn’t taste like anything, so I skip breakfast a lot and just pick at dinner. My belt’s looser… had to pull it in a couple notches.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
Yeah. I’ll be exhausted and still just lie there… thinking about bills, work schedules. Or I wake up around three or four and just stare at the ceiling until I have to get up.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly or feeling like you're speeding up in your thoughts or actions lately?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed speeding up or anything. Maybe I’m a little slower some days, but… I don’t know.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything or like you're worthless?

Yeah… I guess. I keep feeling like I’ve let everybody down. My wife, the kids… the guys at work. If something slips—a missed appointment, a cost overrun, anything safety-related—I just take it as… proof I’m useless. Like maybe everyone would be better off if I wasn’t the one in charge.
Have you had thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?

Yeah… I mean, I haven’t… I don’t know. On those early drives, before anyone’s up, I catch myself thinking maybe it’d be easier if I just didn’t make it there. And sometimes the thought of steering off the road feels… too close. It scares me.
Do you feel like you're moving or reacting more slowly than you used to, or is it the opposite, like you can't seem to slow down?
I don’t really know. I haven’t felt like I’m speeding up. Maybe I’m slower getting going sometimes, but… it’s hard to tell.
Do you feel like your thoughts are racing or that you're having trouble slowing them down?
Not really racing, no. It’s more like… they get stuck on the same things. I don’t feel sped up exactly.
Do you feel like you have less energy or motivation to do things than you used to?
Yeah… definitely less. By midmorning I feel like I’ve already done a full shift. Even just walking the site or taking stairs with the crew feels… heavy, like I’m carrying wet concrete or something.
Do you feel like you're moving or reacting more slowly than you used to?
I’m not sure. Maybe a bit slower getting started, but I haven’t really noticed it clearly.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt better, even if only for a few days?
I don’t know… not really a few days, no. Maybe a moment here or there, but nothing I’d call better.
Have you experienced any strange or unusual thoughts, like hearing voices or seeing things that others can't?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t been hearing voices or seeing things like that.
Have you had any periods in the last two months where you felt completely back to your normal self?
No… not completely. It’s been like this for a long while now—about a year and a half, maybe a little more. Since my wife’s health problems changed things at home.
Are there any small things that still give you some pleasure?

Not much. I mean… I used to look forward to fishing, messing around in the woodshop, even playing chess with the kids. Now the gear just sits in the garage, and when I do any of it, it feels like I’m just… going through the motions.
Have you had any periods in the last month where you felt even slightly better?
Not really. It’s been pretty steady… going on about a year and seven months now, since my wife’s health problems changed everything at home.
